description: This file defines utilities for launching and managing child processes, including process cleanup, signal handling, and process termination logic within the Playwright project.

methods.name: gracefullyCloseAll
methods.description: Closes all processes in the gracefullyCloseSet set.

methods.name: gracefullyProcessExitDoNotHang
methods.description: Exits the process after attempting to gracefully close all processes, with a timeout to prevent hanging.

methods.name: launchProcess
methods.description: Launches a child process with specified options, manages its lifecycle, and provides methods for graceful shutdown and killing.

methods.name: envArrayToObject
methods.description: Converts an array of environment variable objects to a NodeJS.ProcessEnv object.
